checks.name: All sources share one per-round HP budget, regardless of source count
A new round grants exactly one fresh damage budget
Party HP loss is never capped by the enemy membrane
New wound removes the common cap for the two stated rounds, then expires
Damage already spent before wound does not constrain the open window
Wound blocks enemy HP recovery, not party healing
Healing resumes when the debuff expires
A forged personal skill on another actor cannot grant wound
Having Ruka without a thread cannot stop restoration
Spending a thread on the new skill prevents spending it on the old attack bonus
Spending a thread on the old attack prevents the new skill
Zero, broken, consumed or living barriers do not mint stored threads
Optional storage has a cap and multiple expiring allies give one token per round
Final recommendation disables the experimental new leader storage
Sleep, paralysis, charm, confusion and skill-CD lock cannot postpone encounter restoration
Wound stops the environmental HP restore without killing or disabling its actor
